blocks.name: 需求唯一分配
blocks.description: 每个需求点 i 恰好分配给一个设施
blocks.template_snippet:
for i in demand_points:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in facilities) == 1, name=f'assign_{i}')

blocks.name: 分配-开设联动
blocks.description: 只有开设的设施才能接收分配
blocks.math: x_{ij} \leq y_j, \quad \forall i \in I, j \in J

blocks.name: 恰好开设 P 个设施
blocks.description: 恰好开设 p 个设施
blocks.template_snippet: m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[j] for j in facilities) == p, name='open_exactly_p')

blocks.name: 最多开设 P 个设施
blocks.description: 最多开设 p 个设施；当题目说“maximum number of facilities”或“最多 p 个”时使用
blocks.template_snippet: m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[j] for j in facilities) <= p, name='open_at_most_p')

blocks.name: 强制开设设施
blocks.description: 强制开设指定设施
blocks.template_snippet:
for j in forced_open:
    m.addConstr(y[j] == 1, name=f'force_open_{j}')

blocks.name: 强制不开设设施
blocks.description: 禁止开设指定设施
blocks.template_snippet:
for j in forced_closed:
    m.addConstr(y[j] == 0, name=f'force_closed_{j}')

blocks.name: 加权服务距离目标
blocks.description: 最小化需求加权总服务距离
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(demand.get(i, 1) * distance[i, j] * x[i, j] for i in demand_points for j in facilities), GRB.MINIMIZE)

blocks.name: 设施开设成本目标
blocks.description: 最小化设施固定开设成本；若所有 f_j 相同，则等价于最小化设施数量
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(fixed_cost.get(j, 1) * y[j] for j in facilities), GRB.MINIMIZE)

blocks.name: 固定成本加服务成本目标
blocks.description: 最小化设施固定开设成本与需求服务成本之和
blocks.math: \min \sum_{j \in J} f_j y_j + \sum_{i \in I}\sum_{j \in J} c_{ij} x_{ij}
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(fixed_cost[j] * y[j] for j in facilities) + gp.quicksum(service_cost[i, j] * x[i, j] for i in demand_points for j in facilities), GRB.MINIMIZE)

blocks.name: 需求点至少覆盖一次
blocks.description: 每个需求点至少被一个可覆盖它的已开设设施覆盖
blocks.template_snippet:
for i in demand_points:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(coverage_matrix[i, j] * y[j] for j in facilities) >= 1, name=f'cover_{i}')

blocks.name: 需求覆盖状态联动
blocks.description: 只有当至少一个可覆盖需求点 i 的设施被开设时，需求点 i 才能被计为已覆盖
blocks.math: z_i \leq \sum_{j \in J} a_{ij} y_j, \quad \forall i \in I
blocks.template_snippet:
for i in demand_points:
    m.addConstr(z[i] <= gp.quicksum(coverage_matrix[i, j] * y[j] for j in facilities), name=f'coverage_activation_{i}')

blocks.name: 最大化覆盖需求目标
blocks.description: 最大化被覆盖需求点的需求量或权重之和
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(demand.get(i, 1) * z[i] for i in demand_points), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

blocks.name: 最小化最大服务距离目标
blocks.description: 最小化所有需求点到其服务设施距离中的最大值
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(w, GRB.MINIMIZE)

blocks.name: 最大服务距离上界
blocks.description: 用辅助变量 w 约束所有实际分配的服务距离，确保 w 不小于任一被选择分配边的距离
blocks.math: d_{ij} x_{ij} \leq w, \quad \forall i \in I, j \in J

blocks.name: 背包容量约束
blocks.description: 总重量不超过容量
blocks.template_snippet: m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(weight[i]*x[i] for i in items) <= capacity)

blocks.name: 最大化选取价值目标
blocks.description: 最大化所选物品的价值之和
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(value[i] * x[i] for i in items), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

blocks.name: 总服务距离目标（不加权）
blocks.description: 最小化分配边上的服务距离之和，不使用需求权重；与加权服务距离目标不同
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(distance[i, j] * x[i, j] for i in demand_points for j in facilities), GRB.MINIMIZE)

blocks.name: 设施容量约束
blocks.description: 分配给某设施的需求量之和不超过该设施容量，未开设的设施容量为 0；与 knapsack_capacity（单背包总重量不超过容量）语义不同
blocks.math: \sum_{i \in I} d_i x_{ij} \leq Q_j y_j, \quad \forall j \in J
blocks.template_snippet:
for j in facilities:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(demand[i] * x[i, j] for i in demand_points) <= facility_capacity[j] * y[j], name=f'capacity_{j}')

blocks.name: 分配距离上限
blocks.description: 需求点只能分配给服务距离不超过上限的设施；超出上限的分配边固定为 0

blocks.name: 分配可用性
blocks.description: 用 0-1 可用矩阵限制哪些需求点可以由哪些设施服务
blocks.math: x_{ij} \leq a_{ij}, \quad \forall i \in I, j \in J

blocks.name: 开设预算约束
blocks.description: 已开设设施的固定成本之和不超过预算上限
blocks.template_snippet: m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(fixed_cost[j] * y[j] for j in facilities) <= opening_budget, name='opening_budget')

blocks.name: 设施最小间距约束
blocks.description: 用辅助变量 D 约束任意两个已开设设施之间的距离，使 D 不大于最小设施间距；M 为足够大的常数
blocks.math: D \leq d_{jk} + M\,(2 - y_j - y_k), \quad \forall j < k

blocks.name: 分配覆盖状态联动
blocks.description: 需求点 i 被计为覆盖，当且仅当它被分配到的设施能够覆盖它
blocks.math: z_i \leq \sum_{j \in J} a_{ij} x_{ij}, \quad \forall i \in I
blocks.template_snippet:
for i in demand_points:
    m.addConstr(z[i] <= gp.quicksum(coverage_matrix[i, j] * x[i, j] for j in facilities), name=f'assignment_coverage_{i}')

blocks.name: 服务成本目标
blocks.description: 最小化需求分配到设施的服务成本之和，不含设施固定成本
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(service_cost[i, j] * x[i, j] for i in demand_points for j in facilities), GRB.MINIMIZE)

blocks.name: 最大化最小设施间距目标
blocks.description: 最大化任意两个已开设设施之间的最小距离
blocks.template_snippet: m.setObjective(dmin, GRB.MAXIMIZE)
